title: Raymarch
description: Five balls merge into a cube in a single raymarching pass. A 'use gpu' function supplies a distance field built with @typegpu/sdf. Rays come from the orbit camera, and @typegpu/color supplies Oklab colours. The final pass applies post-processing, and FXAA smooths edges.
line: Balls melting into a cube, a distance field marched per pixel, its edges smoothed with FXAA.
hint: drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
